feeds.title: College of Makeup Art & Design Blog
feeds.description: Check out the CMU Blog for graduate success stories, CMU in the media and much much more. CMU has prepared more than 5000 artists for exciting careers in film & television, fashion, theatre, and digital and special effects. We are sought out by creative minds across North America and around the globe. Our makeup courses are taught by award-winning instructors in an intimate classroom setting.

feeds.title: SFX Zone
feeds.description: SFX makeup and special effects. Tutorials, product reviews, artist spotlight, tips and tricks. SFXzone was started in the summer of 2021 with a desire to disseminate knowledge and create a social platform within special effects make-up, prosthetics, theater make-up, cosplay and prop construction. But also in other disciplines such as costume design, atmosphere effects, stage lighting, halloween decorations, themed entertainment design and also haunted houses.

feeds.title: Helsinglight Blog
feeds.description: Follow us at Helsinglight and take part in our magical adventures. Learn to create incredible effects with our courses and products, and get tips and inspiration from our blog posts. Don't miss our creative conferences and magical events. Start your journey with us today

feeds.title: Camera Ready Cosmetics Blogs
feeds.description: Get the latest information on beauty products and makeup tutorials including our SFX Makeup tutorials. We were founded nearly 20 years ago by professional makeup artist Mary Erickson. Mary had the vision and entrepreneurial courage to create a new type of professional makeup store where artists could find the products they need and experiment with them without the typical makeup store experience.

feeds.title: The Art of Makeup School » Special Effects Makeup
feeds.description: Explore our articles on Special Effect makeups, tips and advice for better makeup techniques and more! The Art of Makeup is a boutique career school that provides quality education in the art, business, and techniques of professional makeup artistry.

feeds.title: The Makeup Armoury Blog
feeds.description: Expert insight, articles, and interviews with top artists from all corners of the professional makeup industry. New Makeup Store selling the best SFX and pro makeup brands. The Makeup Armoury was established in 2016 by seasoned veteran of the Film and TV industry, Jan Sewell, reinforced by her dedicated and clued-up team of makeup aficionados. Our sole determination is to equip make up artists with the highest quality products, providing everything from beauty and Special FX to prosthetics and hair.

feeds.title: Tracy Hogg Makeup Artistry Blog
feeds.description: The purpose of this blog is to have an academic record of this year including photography modules, business studies and finally New practical skills learned in order to produce four main images representing a topic of my choice which will be researched and concluded with a three-thousand word dissertation. Starting with studying with a Higher National Diploma in Makeup Artistry at college in Scotland, I am now at the next level of doing my BA (Hons) in Media Makeup with Hair design and Special effects at York College partnered with Open University.

feeds.title: SFX makeup
feeds.description: I'm Hla Moawad. I'm a self-taught makeup artist, especially in special effect makeup (SFX). Learn more about SFX with my articles, videos and more in this blog.

feeds.title: Rachael Divers Blog
feeds.description: Get the latest beauty reviews and tutorials. My name is Rachael and I'm an award-winning makeup artist, beauty writer and YouTube content creator. I've been in love with makeup for as long as I can remember, and as a trained writer, too, it wasn't long until my two passions collided resulting in this very blog. If you love all things beauty with a sprinkling of fashion and lifestyle, then you're certainly in the right place.
